## Data and Methods

### Hourly marginal distribution costs {#sec-method-dist-mc}

The distribution and sub-transmission marginal cost series shown in @fig-mc-heatmap-dist-sub-tx is an hourly schedule covering all 8,760 hours of 2025, built in four steps.

**Step 1: Annualized marginal capacity cost.** We used the system-wide annualized marginal distribution station and trunkline feeder cost of **$20.17/kW-year** (2026 dollars) from Table 3 of Eversource's marginal cost of service study (MCOS), filed in its 2026 rate case, Docket 26-05-10 [@eversource_Docket260510Exhibit_2026; @eversource_Docket260510Exhibit_2026a] [[p. 7](https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28540599-exhibit-clp-mcos-2/#document/p7/a2826034)]. This is the system-wide average — Eversource diluted the locational cost in expansion areas ($86.58/kW-year) by the share of system peak load in those areas — and covers upstream distribution only (substations and primary trunkline feeders).

**Step 2: CPI adjustment.** We deflated $20.17/kW-year to 2025 dollars using the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers [@fred_ConsumerPriceIndexAll_2025], yielding **$19.65/kW-year**.[^cpi-2026-partial]

[^cpi-2026-partial]: The 2026 CPI value is a partial-year average; the deflation factor is 0.974.

**Step 3: Peak-hour identification.** We loaded hourly load for the ISO-NE Connecticut load zone for calendar year 2025 [@isone_ISONEWebServices_2025], ranked all 8,760 hours by load, and selected the **top 100 hours** as the constrained hours — all of which fall in June, July, and August.

**Step 4: Load-weighted allocation.** We allocated the annualized cost across those 100 hours proportional to each hour's share of total load in the peak window:

$$
w_h = \frac{L_h}{\sum_{k \in \text{top-100}} L_k}
$$

Multiplying $19.65/kW-year by each hour's weight gives that hour's marginal cost in $/kWh; all remaining hours are zero. The resulting hourly profile is @fig-mc-heatmap-dist-sub-tx.

**Limitation.** The ISO-NE Connecticut zone load covers both Eversource and United Illuminating; no comparable MCOS exists for United Illuminating, so this schedule applies to Eversource only.
